title: Frontend design system metadata

drift.summary: The design direction is useful, but the app has moved quickly through Project Hub, board cards, and Wiki shell refinements.
rationale: Shared sidebar components are now more important than the older page-level guidance suggests.
Navigation persistence and splitters need to be part of the explicit design contract.
The document should distinguish current implemented controls from desired patterns.

duplicates.rationale: The document overlaps with newer style-guide pages; keep it as the umbrella only if the detailed controls stay delegated.

nextAction: Add a current navigation and shell section that references the shared sidebar components.
